svg.title: ZeroCloudGravity R0..R3 Capability Rings, Google OIDC PKCE, TLS 1.3 and 3-World Domain Isolation
svg.desc: Blueprint diagram illustrating monotonic R0 to R3 surface rings, progressive Google OIDC S256 PKCE session elevation, TLS 1.3 transport hardening, and isolated OSS, Corporate, and Personal domains.
svg.text: BLUEPRINT 02 · MONOTONIC R0..R3 CAPABILITY RINGS, GOOGLE OIDC PKCE & TLS 1.3 TRANSPORT
Progressive Web Elevation (/auth/oidc/login S256 PKCE -> __zcg_session) + Zero-Literal Runtime IAM
PRE-BODY ASGI RING & DISCLOSURE PROJECTION (R0 < R1 < R2 < R3)
R0 · public (core_summary) — Open Visitors & Sliding-Window Rate Cap
/portal (OSS 3D Atlas | Personal CV | Corporate Brand), /stewardship, /.well-known/*
429 SURFACE_RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED · 404 DOCS_DISABLED in pro · sha384 SRI guard
R1 · scoped-external (verified_competency) — guest | linked-peer
ZCG_SCOPED_EXTERNAL_EMAILS or bilateral zcg link Bearer · Route fnmatch containment
Unlocks expanded A4 PDF / .md / .json CV dossier & B2B capsules while blocking R2
R2 · network-member (day1_onboarding) — Workspace / Cloud Identity + Groups
Google IAP JWT or OIDC S256 PKCE (email_verified: true, hd + required_groups)
Departmental RBAC: dept-finance accesses R2 treasury; others get 403 GROUP_FORBIDDEN
R3 · operator (deep_context) — Sovereign Owner / Maintainer Plane
ZCG_OPERATOR_EMAILS or *.localhost loopback · Full /dashboard + ?tier= CV preview
3 ISOLATED IDENTITY & DOMAIN WORLDS (0 GIT LITERALS)
World 1 · OSS Platform: zerocloudgravity.org + .dev
Public R0 Flagship + Workspace OIDC (maintainer@ R3, validators@ R2)
World 2 · Enterprise: <corp>.com (Public) + <corp>.net (Intranet)
.com E2EE Mail intact · .net on Cloud Identity Free ($0 Gmail cost)
World 3 · Personal Sovereign: *.localhost + pub-<persona>
Non-Gmail Google OIDC -> R3 on own node, R1 guest on partner nodes
STDLIB OPENSSL 3 TLS 1.3 / mTLS & KEYLESS CLOUD RUN CD
• Loopback *.localhost HTTP = W3C Secure Context (0 HSTS pollution)
• Non-loopback blocks plaintext (PLAINTEXT_NON_LOOPBACK_BLOCKED)
• Keyless GitHub OIDC WIF -> Cloud Run UID 10001 (dev -> tst -> pre -> pro)
HSTS + ; Secure cookies auto-enabled on TLS 1.3 & CIDR X-Forwarded-Proto
